title: Training-data audit — combined v5full-v2 + §4 targeted curriculum

v5fullV2Baseline.note: Original frame-level dataset. Zero confirmed victories — the measured weakness the §4 curriculum targets.

curriculumAdditions.note: Real pinned-engine matches captured to fill the decisive-outcome gap (4 confirmed victories added) and broaden opponent/mode coverage. Combined with v5full-v2 to 62 matches / 12765 frames.

wholeMatchSplit.method: sideOf(matchId, splitPct=21) — deterministic, whole-match (a match is entirely train or entirely val; no frame leaks across the boundary)
wholeMatchSplit.note: Val is the held-out majority (~79% of groups), so valRankLoss/valCrossStd are generalization estimates, not in-sample.

holdoutSeedNamespace.note: v5fh-* is a fresh, previously-unused seed namespace for the §8 final holdout.

labeling.recomputedAtTrainTime: trainer/v5-labels.cjs buildLabels (frame-level heldGain/lossRisk over a 600-tick horizon, landScale 800)
labeling.note: Frame-level labels are the §3 root-cause of the old near-constant scores; the §5 ranking objective fixes that without changing the label pipeline.

gate: §4 curriculum gate passed (decisive-outcome coverage achieved: 4 confirmed victories present in the combined set; see campaign record).
